layouts.name: North long course, 2014
layouts.description: The AMA Pro operator plan identifies the 2.75-mile North long course with its complete Western outer return and inner hairpin, Northern esses, Eastern terminal turns and long front straight. The complete independently mapped 2014 road loop follows those branches. Historical alignment remains draft.

layouts.name: North track with Western connecting branches, 2014
layouts.description: The NOLA operator plan identifies the curved turn-3A shortcut between the Western inner hairpin approach and Northern course. The 2014 independent mapping also records a Western connecting return to the front straight. This mapped branch configuration includes those connections and the Northern course, retains exact independent source nodes, and remains draft because the operator plan does not name this complete combination as a race lap.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The catalogue course footprint includes the North long course, its Western inner hairpin, the curved turn-3A shortcut and the Western front-straight connection. The reviewed 2014 independent source provides every branch as two complete mapped loops. The operator's NOLA plan identifies the long course and turn-3A shortcut; the extra connecting return follows the independent road mapping. Historical corner alignment and the unnamed branch combination remain draft. The independent unique branch distance is 4888.9 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
